What does each AI agent do?
Cut edits your footage, Hue grades the color, Nova generates new shots, Echo mixes the sound and Flow animates titles. Run one agent or all five on the same timeline.
Which video editing software does Kaviyan work with?
Kaviyan connects to the video editing software you already use. The agents work inside your own project and timeline, so nothing has to be exported or rebuilt.
Do I need to know how to edit video?
No. Describe what you want in plain words and the agents draft it. Editors stay in control: every cut, grade and effect remains fully editable.
